notes: Faster healing and more cleric heals. The Healer now runs on its own quicker think interval and a shorter re-fire guard, and the cast gap was tightened, so spells go off promptly once they are actually ready instead of waiting out an extra beat. New heals: Panacea, Positive Energy Burst, Cure Minor Wounds, Mass Lesser/Greater Vigor, Mass Vigor and Mass Regenerate. Self-centred burst heals are now handled correctly (measured from the caster, no target selection), and mass heal-over-time spells no longer re-cast while still ticking on the group.
